_comment: AI images for the opening journey, with the round thing that sits in the record window (in source pixels). The sources are the PNGs in the Drive folder academy-ai (see AI-PROMPTS.md), downloaded to ../ai-images/ (not in git). Each entry: {"id": "jog", "src": "path/to/05-jog.png", "focus": [x, y, r]}, plus optionally "src_l" / "focus_l" for a separate 16:9 image (without it wide screens use the portrait crop). The id matches data-scene in index.html. Run tools/zoom-crops.py after changing and paste the printed attributes on that .jr-scene.
